# 卡列表

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /v2/getCardList:
    post:
      summary: 卡列表
      deprecated: false
      description: |-
        > V2 无需加密，请求直接提交本页所示的明文 JSON，返回的 `data` 即为本页所示的明文对象。

        获取账户下的卡列表，支持条件筛选查询
      tags:
        - VM卡操作 V2（所有账户可用，推荐）
      parameters:
        - name: Authorization
          in: header
          description: ''
          example: '{{Authorization}}'
          schema:
            type: string
            default: '{{Authorization}}'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                product_code:
                  type: string
                card_type:
                  type: string
                  description: save：储值卡，share：额度卡
                  title: 卡类型
                card_id:
                  type: string
                  title: 卡ID
                  description: 后续将废弃card_id，建议采用vm_card_id
                start_time:
                  type: string
                end_time:
                  type: string
                page:
                  type: integer
                page_size:
                  type: integer
                status:
                  type: string
                  description: ACTIVE：激活，CANCELLED：冻结，DELETED：删除
                  title: 卡状态
                vm_card_id:
                  type: string
                  title: vm卡ID
              x-apifox-orders:
                - product_code
                - card_type
                - status
                - card_id
                - vm_card_id
                - start_time
                - end_time
                - page
                - page_size
            example:
              product_code: P537***
              card_type: save
              card_id: abcd123456789
              vm_card_id: v4Qg*************HHSfg
              start_time: '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
              end_time: '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
              page: 1
              page_size: 10
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  msg:
                    type: string
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      total:
                        type: integer
                        description: 条目数
                      list:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            card_id:
                              type: string
                            card_number:
                              type: string
                            product_code:
                              type: string
                            card_type:
                              type: string
                            available_amount:
                              type: number
                              description: 卡余额
                            status:
                              type: string
                            create_time:
                              type: string
                            vm_card_id:
                              type: string
                          x-apifox-orders:
                            - card_id
                            - vm_card_id
                            - card_number
                            - product_code
                            - card_type
                            - available_amount
                            - status
                            - create_time
                          required:
                            - vm_card_id
                    required:
                      - total
                    x-apifox-orders:
                      - total
                      - list
                required:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
                x-apifox-orders:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: VM卡操作 V2（所有账户可用，推荐）
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/6388598/apis/api-531010372-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: https://sandbox-api.vmcardio.com
    description: API开发者
security: []

```
